Looking at the two traces, both follow similar logical paths—deducing Cloth=1713, Leather=1711, and Elm∈{1714,1715,1716}—but diverge in how they explore the Elm possibilities. Trace 1 explores Elm=1714 first (fails), then Elm=1716 (succeeds), then backtracks to re-explore Elm=1714 and Elm=1715. Trace 2 eliminates Elm=Y15 first (4 items in 2 slots), then explores Elm=Y16 (succeeds), then tests alternative S1 assignments (Y16, Y15). Both traces re-verify eliminated branches at the end—Trace 1 re-explores Elm=1714 and Elm=1715, Trace 2 re-verifies S1=Y16/Y15 and Elm=Y15. Neither trace produces a divergent branch that pays off differently; both arrive at the same solution.
